summary: Putting on/taking off soul speed boots while standing on soul sand/soil does not properly give speed
description:
## The Bug

Putting on soul speed boots while standing on soul blocks gives you no speed. Likewise, taking off soul speed boots while standing on soul blocks doesn't take away your speed until you move off of the block.

## Steps to Reproduce

 - Replace the ground beneath you with some soul soil.

 /fill ~-2 ~-1 ~-2 ~2 ~-1 ~2 minecraft:soul_soil

 - Equip some boots enchanted with soul speed whilst standing on top of the soul soil.

/item replace entity @s armor.feet with minecraft:golden_boots{Enchantments:[{id:"soul_speed",lvl:3}]}

 → Notice how the soul speed enchantment effect is not granted until you begin moving.

 - Remove the boots from your feet whilst the soul speed enchantment effect is active.

/item replace entity @s armor.feet with minecraft:air

 → Notice how the soul speed enchantment effect is not removed until you begin moving.

## Observed Behavior

Equipping or unequipping boots enchanted with soul speed whilst standing on soul blocks doesn't correctly grant or remove the soul speed enchantment effect.

## Expected Behavior

Equipping or unequipping boots enchanted with soul speed whilst standing on soul blocks would correctly grant or remove the soul speed enchantment effect. Upon equipping some soul speed boots whilst standing on soul blocks, the soul speed enchantment effect should be immediately granted without having the need to move. Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft and create a Creative world with default settings.
2. Stand on the ground and run `/fill ~-2 ~-1 ~-2 ~2 ~-1 ~2 minecraft:soul_soil`.
3. While standing on top of the soul soil, run `/item replace entity @s armor.feet with minecraft:golden_boots{Enchantments:[{id:"soul_speed",lvl:3}]}`.
4. Observe that the Soul Speed effect is not granted while you remain stationary.
5. Move while remaining on the soul soil and observe that the Soul Speed effect becomes active.
6. While the Soul Speed effect is active, run `/item replace entity @s armor.feet with minecraft:air`.
7. Observe that the Soul Speed effect remains active until you move off the soul soil.

Observed Behavior:
When Soul Speed–enchanted boots are equipped while the player is already standing on soul sand or soul soil, the Soul Speed movement bonus is not applied immediately. The player continues moving at the normal speed until they move.

Conversely, when the boots are removed while the player is still standing on soul sand or soul soil, the Soul Speed movement bonus remains active until the player moves. The movement-speed calculation is therefore not updated when the equipped boots change; it is only refreshed after movement begins.
Expected Behavior: Equipping boots enchanted with Soul Speed while standing on soul sand or soul soil should immediately grant the associated speed benefit without requiring the player to move. Removing those boots while remaining on the soul block should immediately remove the benefit as well, so the active effect always reflects the currently equipped footwear.
